main_text.l: Calumnia, quæ huic viro,optimo,doctis-
simo,& de Ecclesia Catholica bene meri-
to impingitur, impulit me ad hanc Epi-
stolam Eminentiæ vestræ scribendam, ut
veritati testimonium debitum perhibeā,
&innocentiam à malevolis iniquissimè
appetitam, quantum in me est asseram,
verum equidem est, nec diffiteor, librum [illegible,
~3 letters]lum cum plurimis aliis & doctoribus
& Episcopis se probasse. Sed id factum
est, cum primùm Galliæ innotuit, an-
tequam turbines, qvi postea illius causa
commoti sunt, in orbe Christiano exci-
tati fuissent; videbat librum ab Episcopo
Catholicæ communionis compositum,
cujus autor omnes labores suos Ecclesiæ
Romanæ emendandos & expungen-
dos humillimé subjiciebat; videbat
librum in Belgio á librorum Censoribus
examine facto probatum & commendatum,
& duplici privilegio Imperatoris &
regis Catholici munitum; videbat
librum á multis viris doctis in Gallia ma-
gni fieri, á nemine tum attentatum.; librum
legit, quæstiones varias&populares

page.notes: Black ink blot covers the start of the word at the beginning of the ninth line; only "lum" is visible, so the word is illegible. Some spots and specks on the page are not printed text. Possible misprint "attentatum.;" with the stray full stop kept as printed. The "to impingitur" word break in line 3 looks like a single word on the scan and is copied as seen.
